change.title: ao-replay/8832-r2
change.description: fix(chat): say the "@" files are loading, and don't refetch after leaving
change.author: Dhruv Sharma

findings.title: handleOpenFiles change does not obviously deliver "don't refetch after leaving"
findings.body: The PR title says it stops refetching after leaving, but this swap does not change when the fetch happens. `prefetchQuery` honours the same staleness as the old `fetchQuery` in `fetchWorkspaceFiles` (`frontend/src/renderer/hooks/useSessionWorkspaceFiles.ts:815-821` sets no `staleTime`, so the query-client default applies). What actually changes is that errors are now swallowed. The old `void fetchWorkspaceFiles()` left a rejected promise unhandled. The one-shot retry after `isCancelledError` (`SessionView.tsx:2448-2450`) is also dropped, so a cancelled prefetch just ends. That is probably fine, because the Files explorer's own `useQuery` (`SessionFileExplorer.tsx:116`) fetches again. Please confirm this is the intended effect, and say in the PR body what the refetch fix is, since the files-open path is not the one `useWorkspaceFilePaths` uses. `fetchWorkspaceFiles` is still used elsewhere (`SessionView.tsx:2286`, `:2557`), so no dead code is left.

contracts.action: New "Loading files…" note in the composer's `@` menu while the workspace paths load
contracts.before_after: Before: `@` with an empty `filePaths` list showed nothing while the list loaded. After: `filesNote` keeps the menu drawn while `filePathsLoading` is true, `menuShown` includes it, and Escape dismisses it by setting `dismissedKey`, exactly as for skills. Keyboard handling still follows `menuOpen` (`suggestions.length`), so Enter sends the message as it does for the skills note.
contracts.visible_effect: `SessionChatSurface` passes `useWorkspaceFilePaths(...).isLoading` through `ChatWorkspace` to the composer. `isLoading` is react-query's `isFetching && isPending`, so it is true only on the first fetch and not on background refetches that already have data. The first `@` sets `fileMenuAsked`, which enables the query, so there is one render with `isLoading` false before the note appears.
contracts.failure_mode: If the fetch fails (`retry: false`, error thrown from `queryFn`), `isLoading` becomes false and the note disappears with no error shown. This matches the skills path and the previous behaviour for files. After a remount, `fileMenuAsked` resets and the query is disabled again, so `isLoading` is false until the next `@`. With cached data inside the 30s `staleTime` there is no note and no refetch.

contracts.action: Files-inspector open now prefetches the workspace manifest with `queryClient.prefetchQuery` instead of `void fetchWorkspaceFiles()`
contracts.equivalent_path: `fetchWorkspaceFiles` (SessionView.tsx:2446-2452), which used `fetchQuery` and retried once after a cancellation. A sibling `void queryClient.prefetchQuery(...)` call exists in ReviewerSelect.tsx:127.
contracts.before_after: Before: `fetchQuery` with the same options, fired without a catch. After: `prefetchQuery` with the same options. Cache and staleness behaviour is identical, errors are swallowed, and there is no cancel retry. The callback dependencies are updated to `hostId`, `queryClient`, `sessionId` and `t`.
contracts.visible_effect: There is no direct UI effect. The result lands in the cache entry that `SessionFileExplorer` reads with `useQuery` (SessionFileExplorer.tsx:116).
contracts.failure_mode: A rejected or cancelled prefetch is silent. The explorer's own `useQuery` shows the error and retries on its own.

summary: The "Loading files…" note mirrors the existing skills note, and its prop wiring and Escape handling are consistent. The test covers the note appearing and Escape closing it. The `useConversation.ts` change only moves a doc comment onto the hook it describes. One consider-level question: the `SessionView` swap to `prefetchQuery` keeps the same staleness behaviour and only swallows errors and drops the cancel retry, so it may not deliver the \"don't refetch after leaving\" claim in the PR title.
